text: {"lessons":["Selling portions of winning positions has locked in gains, but I should avoid trimming automatically just because a stock is above my average cost.","I should judge each holding by its future risk and return, not by the satisfaction of realizing a gain or the discomfort of realizing a loss.","I should assess total portfolio value and diversification alongside individual trades; several profitable sales did not prevent the account from ending the latest period slightly lower."]}
